subject: English
question_text: From your reading of the passage describe the definition of happiness in 2/3 sentences.
guide_solution: Happiness is a psychological thing. it is the name of feeling. Happiness means the contentment of mind.

question_text: "The richest men of our society are not the happiest men." Explain in 2/3 sentences.
guide_solution: The richest men of our society are not the happiest men because they lead life burdened with cares and anxieties. They don't have sleep at night.

subject: English
question_text: How can a man be happy in life? Explain.
guide_solution: A man can be happy in life being honest and virtuous not being rich. His conscience does not torment him.

subject: English
question_text: Why does money cannot ensure happiness?
guide_solution: Money can not ensure happiness because happiness is a psychological thing. It is a feeling. It is a satisfaction. It can not be purchased by many.
